annotations.text:
Your mark, refined and extended into a system — then the product rebuilt in its language.

Four changes to the logo: baselines aligned so the V and wordmark read as one lockup; tracking put in order so the tagline steps back instead of competing; a heavier optical cut for small sizes, where didone hairlines break up; and the whole thing stated as lockups, reversal, palette and type scale.

Bodoni Moda for the wordmark and headlines, Jost for labels and copy, IBM Plex Mono for figures only — decimals have to align in a compliance table.

No brand colour anywhere. Paper and ink carry the interface; green, oxblood and grey appear only where a rule passed, failed, or could not be checked.
The dark version running today, for comparison.
